description: Identify what an object is from one to four sizes you measured (an outline, a bore, a pin, a flange) when you do not know its name; use find_geometry when you do. Each size is compared, within tolerance_mm, against every object's overall size in any order and against its exact feature sizes (bores, slots, pins, size-table rows). Results are ranked with all overall sizes matching first, then by the number of matching features, and each says which of your numbers matched where. No match is not an error: widen tolerance_mm (0.2 suits caliper readings of machined parts, 1 suits rough measurements) or file request_object. Read-only, no auth, no charge; same catalog snapshot as find_geometry.

category.description: Exact category from list_categories, to narrow the search.

sizes_mm.description: One to four measured sizes in mm, e.g. [40, 80] for a profile or [10.5] for a bore.

name: find_by_dimensions

all_overall_sizes_match.description: True when every size you gave matched an overall dimension.

free_files.description: Free STEP/STL files on the object.

items.description: A mating feature that matched: feature, exact size, what it mates with, fit class, and which of your sizes matched.

overall_mm.description: The object's overall size in mm.

size_table_rows_matched.description: Rows of the object's size table containing a matching number.

slug.description: Object slug for the other tools.

total.description: Objects with at least one match.

title: Identify an object from measured sizes
